text: ok. so, how i would then ask for the shape to be is that the on-disk file is the entire source of truth, meaning, it somewhere in its data package, declares its a prop or a build piece, and its not just based on a local store, the local store can effectively read the disk or we could have a scan button to run over them and index for faster reads but storing them indefinitely that way i think is a downfall dont you think

events.text: USER RULING for the prop/piece export slice (rides req_2712): the on-disk model package is the ENTIRE source of truth — the package itself declares prop vs build piece (placeable status + rig in manifest). Localstore never stores this indefinitely; it may only act as a derived cache/index rebuilt by reading the disk (boot scan or scan button).

resolution: Ruling implemented: the on-disk model package is the ENTIRE source of truth for placeability. The manifest now carries placeable ({as:'build-piece',kind}|{as:'prop'}) + the exported skeleton; the palette boot-derives from scanning materialized manifests (bootAuthoredPieces); localstore is a rebuildable cache only — legacy cache-only exports backfill their manifests on mount, and entries whose package is gone drop instead of resurrecting. materializeModelPackage preserves an existing manifest's export declaration so a stale-session re-save can never clobber it.
